headline: IT and Office Systems Staff
summary: IT and office systems staff with four years at a feed mill, covering both computers and the administrative office. I keep PCs, printers and the office network working, handle user support and security reminders, and run the document filing and data entry that keep purchasing and payroll moving.

experience.title: IT and Office Systems Staff
experience.paragraph: A combined role: I am the only IT person on site and also part of the three-person administrative office.
bullets: Support 45 users with computers, Microsoft Office, email and the accounting software.
Look after the office network, Wi-Fi and the link to the weighbridge computer, and call the provider when the line fails.
Remind staff about strong passwords and suspicious emails, and set up screen locks on shared PCs.
Set up the office's digital filing system and scan purchase orders and delivery receipts into it.
Encode daily production and delivery figures and maintain the photocopiers, printers and biometric time clock.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Office Administration
